Database transactions can deadlock even when individual queries are correct due to the way transactions are scheduled and managed by the database system. Deadlocks occur when two or more transactions are waiting for each other to release resources they hold, creating a circular wait. This situation can happen even if the individual transactions are logically correct and do not contain any errors.

### Why Deadlocks Can Happen Even When Individual Queries Are Correct
